name: Turkey
description: Turkey is a transcontinental country known for its rich history, vibrant culture, and growing economy. It's a popular destination for international students due to its affordable tuition fees and a wide range of academic programs.
visa_info: Students from most countries will need to apply for a student visa at a Turkish embassy or consulate. A letter of final acceptance from a university is required for the application.
living_costs: The cost of living in Turkey is relatively low compared to many European countries. Monthly expenses for a student can range from $300 to $1000, depending on the city and lifestyle.

name: Malaysia
description: Malaysia is a Southeast Asian country known for its diverse culture, modern cities, and beautiful landscapes. It is a popular destination for international students due to its high-quality education system and affordable living costs.
visa_info: Students from most countries will need to apply for a student visa (Student Pass) at the Malaysian embassy or consulate in their home country. A letter of acceptance from a recognized educational institution is required for the application.
living_costs: The cost of living in Malaysia is relatively low compared to many Western countries. Monthly expenses for a student can range from $300 to $800, depending on the city and lifestyle.

name: Russia
description: Russia is the largest country in the world, known for its rich cultural heritage, diverse landscapes, and strong emphasis on education. It attracts international students with its affordable tuition fees and a wide range of academic programs.
visa_info: Students from most countries will need to apply for a student visa at a Russian embassy or consulate. A letter of acceptance from a recognized educational institution is required for the application.
living_costs: The cost of living in Russia varies depending on the city, but it is generally affordable. Monthly expenses for a student can range from $250 to $700, depending on the location and lifestyle.
